editorial.blurb: A hidden gem in Lincoln Square serving authentic Mexican food with standout quesabirria that's worth the trip.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Quesabirria and don't skip the consommé dip—reviewers rave about drinking it after the meal. Fair warning: no frills, walk-in service, but quality draws crowds quickly.

topDishes.note: Spectacular cheese pull with flavorful consommé for dipping
Warm, satisfying, pairs perfectly with their green juice
